biggest_catch: The friend must complete heavy qualification within 90 days of opening - 10 debit card transactions of $10+ AND two direct deposits of $500+ (real paycheck/benefit deposits, not Zelle or transfers) - and the $100 comes as a virtual Visa gift card, not cash.
catches: Referrer: 18+, active customer in good standing with an eligible checking account, registered for the Program; refer via email (valid contact info) or social/text with the Required Disclosure text.
Referrer earns a $100 Reward per Referred Individual who completes all Qualifying Activities, for qualifying accounts opened on or after 3/1/2026.
Cap: $500 per calendar year per participant (as referrer, referred, or both); no partial rewards.
Friend must: register via the referral link; open a qualifying checking account within 90 days; not have been primary owner of an FFB checking in the past 12 months.

Friend Qualifying Activities (consumer): 10+ debit card transactions of $10+ within 90 days of opening; two direct deposits of $500+ within 90 days (paycheck/pension/benefits only - Zelle, Venmo, P2P, and transfers do not qualify).
Reward form: virtual Visa Reward Card delivered to the registered Program email ~3 weeks after activities complete; expires 6 months after issuance.
Rewards subject to IRS tax reporting; employees and household members ineligible.
Program Period continues until FFB cancels it; terms subject to change or cancellation without notice.

steps: Register for the First Financial Bank Refer-A-Friend Program and accept the terms.
Refer friends by email (valid contact info) or share your unique link via social/text with the Required Disclosure.
Friend registers via your link, opens a qualifying checking account within 90 days, and completes the qualifying activities.
You receive a $100 virtual Visa Reward Card per qualifying referral (up to $500/year).
timing: Virtual Visa Reward Card delivered to registered email ~3 weeks after qualifying activities complete.
when_cash_arrives: Virtual Visa Reward Card delivered to registered email ~3 weeks after qualifying activities complete. Roughly a month from the trigger event to cash in hand.
maximize: Trigger the clock early: have your friend complete qualifying activity (direct deposit, debit transactions) in the first days of the window.
Route a real payroll direct deposit (not Zelle/P2P transfers, which most programs exclude) as early as possible - payroll timing is usually the gating step.
If any-amount direct deposit qualifies, a small recurring ACH can trigger it - check the program's 'qualifying deposit' definition first.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the payout window itself is 3-4 weeks after qualification - there is no expedited track.
